desc: R3 right-port (HPM2) detach/rollback design. Status 2026-08-03: R3 remains NO-GO. Static decode found no VBUS primitive anywhere in Apple's class-10 stack (proof by exhaustion over the kernelcache: only the SWDF/SWUF 4CCs exist, encoded as UTF-16 halfwords; no SWSr/SWSk, no issued GAID, no flash/OTP path — ticket 176 confirmed). SWDF/SWUF are DATA-role swaps, so whether VBUS drops on leaving DFP is unproven and must be measured; the 'r3-fully-specified' state was withdrawn 2026-07-29. The 0x18 W1C clear and the blind 0x50 write have no inverse, and no mask/detect restoration path exists. Both irreversible ops are volatile (power-cycle recoverable): this is a completeness verdict, not a danger claim. To close: prove a saved register-0x50 word can be safely written back, decide the 0x18 W1C position, and validate — or design away — the cross-layer teardown order. Do not build or run tickets 102-108 on this evidence. Full decode journal and method notes: see the linked evidence.
